item.title: Scientists reconstruct mouse vision from brain activity
item.description: Researchers reconstructed videos from mouse brain activity, creating 10-second clips based solely on visual cortex neuron signals.

item.title: Solar desalination converts seawater to fresh water, removes brine
item.description: Scientists have created a solar-powered desalination system that converts seawater into fresh water while removing nearly all leftover salt.

item.title: Fossil aged 240 million years alters dinosaur timeline
item.description: A newly identified 240-million-year-old animal from Tanzania is prompting scientists to reconsider the early dinosaur timeline.
